description: QBI base netted by an external QBI-eligible loss (Reg. 1.199A-1(d)(2)(iii); mirrors TaxCalcBench ty25-us-005): MFJ wages 420,000 (box 3 = 168,600), Schedule C 50,000, allowed nonpassive SS 469(c)(7) rental loss 29,000 flagged QBI. QBI pool = (50,000 - half-SE 1,135) - 29,000 = 19,865 -> 20% = $3,973.00 - the reference return's QBI deduction. The wage limit (200,000 W-2 wages paid) does not bind.
